# `media/codecs/AV1Intra.js`

> **Source:** `engine/media/codecs/AV1Intra.js`

Independently authored AV1 Main 8-bit monochrome palette-intra subset. Independent 64x64 two-color palette tiles, static CDFs, skipped residuals, and disabled filters. Arbitrary RGBA input is quantized to two luma values; this is a deliberately restricted standards codec, not a general AV1 decoder. Syntax, integer arithmetic and normative probability constants are specified by https://aomediacodec.github.io/av1-spec/ (chapters 5, 8 and 9).

## Functions

### `encodeAV1PaletteFrame(value, width = SIZE, height = SIZE)`

Encode one independent standards AV1 keyframe, including its sequence OBU.

### `decodeAV1PaletteFrame(value)`

Decode the declared subset in authored JavaScript, without WebCodecs.

### `encodeAV1Intra({ width, height, frameRate = 24, frames } = {})`

Store independent AV1 still-picture sequences in a conventional AV01 IVF file.
